title: Streaming + function-call compatibility verification for newly onboarded model variants
creator: Priya Sharma
description: Goal: Provide an end-to-end verification harness and runbook that certifies newly onboarded model variants for correct streaming semantics when used with function/tool calling and pinned-version routing. This ticket covers behavior verification across the hosted API, Dedicated, and Private modes where pinning, perf-profile publication, and runtime kernel selection may interact with streaming and function-call code paths. The harness should detect regressions introduced by quantized kernels, KV cache reuse, and early-termination or partial-output cases.
scope: 1) Create automated smoke tests that exercise: incremental streaming frames, function/tool call handshake during a stream, mid-stream function-call triggers, early stream termination (client cancel), and fallback to non-streaming full-response path. 2) Validate that model version pinning (model:version tag) preserves streaming + function-call semantics across model variants and that the published performance profile includes a streaming-compatible flag. 3) Add CI gate that fails onboarding if any streaming/function-call ACs fail.
out_of_scope: Detailed performance benchmarking of token throughput (covered by separate perf jobs) and long-running Dedicated autoscaling interactions. Not covering non-Latin tokenization edgecases — those will be separate i18n tickets.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Automated tests simulate a streaming response that yields a function_call event in the middle of the stream and assert that the runtime delivers the function call payload within the same stream without truncation.

AC2: When a client cancels a stream mid-function-call, the runtime must still surface a deterministic partial function_call payload and log a corresponding telemetry event (request_id + model_version + cancel_reason).

AC3: Pinning to model:version (e.g., 'mymodel:2026-02-21') returns the same streaming behavior as unpinned canonical model for the same config; differences are treated as onboarding-blocking unless justified in notes and signed off by Applied ML.

AC4: The perf-profile publish flow must attach a 'streaming_compat=true' tag when the model passes the streaming/function-call harness; the model catalog entry and onboarding checklist reflect this flag.
AC5: CI gate created: onboarding PRs that change streaming/function-call semantics must be blocked until a core runtime owner triages and approves.

notes: This ticket ties into the perf-profile publishing flow. If we mark a model as streaming-compatible but later find regressions for certain pinned variants, the catalog must allow revoking the flag and triggering a re-onboarding. Coordinate with Applied ML for signoff on any exceptions.
